newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI JULY GDP UP 12 PCT YEAR-ON-YEAR -PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI JULY GDP UP 12 PCT YEAR-ON-YEAR -PAPER.

text.p: Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP) hit 27.49 billion yuan ($3.31 billion) in July 1997, up 12 percent compared with July 1996, the Business News said on Thursday.
In the first seven months of 1997, Shanghai's GDP reached 181.86 billion yuan, up 13.5 percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
In July, total industrial output value was 45.05 billion yuan, a rise of 10.8 percent from July 1996, with the growth of heavy industry higher than that of light industry, it said.
The output value of heavy industry was 25.24 billion yuan in July, up a year-on-year 14.8 percent, while the output value of light industry rose by 5.8 percent to 19.81 billion yuan, it said.
Total retail consumption value was 10.56 billion yuan in July, up 15.7 percent from the year-ago period after taking inflation into account, the newspaper said.
In addition, Shanghai's exports grew steadily in July, with the value hitting 1.232 billion yuan, up 4.5 percent from July 1996, it said.
Direct foreign investment in the city reached $982 million in July, surging a year-on-year 82.6 percent, it added.
